title: Doja Cat & Latto Team Up for Sexy 2000s-Themed ‘Okayyy’ Video, Atlanta Rapper to Join Doja’s Ma Vie World Tour
summary: The North American leg of Doja's trek kicks off Oct. 1 in Detroit.
contentText:
Doja Cat and Latto are making their case for rap’s hottest duo in 2026. The steamy 2000s-coded visual for their “Okayyy” collaboration arrived on Tuesday (July 21).

The sultry clip kicks off with Latto rapping in lingerie from the comfort of her silk bedsheets before heading to the bathroom, where she poses while taking flicks with a classic digital camera that dominated the MySpace selfie era.

She returns donning camouflage and records in the bedroom, as she’s surrounded by bodybuilders who won’t dare to look her way.

Doja enters the picture in pink lingerie and pays a visit to her man in prison, who’s treated to the Grammy-winning artist giving a chair a sexy-yet-tantalizing lap dance on the other side of the glass.

Doja and Latto reunite for various shots in front of a baby-blue backdrop before heading back to the mansion, which hilariously finds the crew of muscular men washing their luxury cars in the driveway.

Fans seemed to be enjoying the eye candy with Doja and Latto linking up for the steamy visual. “WHOEVER PUT THEM TOGETHER DESERVES A RAISE,” one person wrote in the YouTube video’s comments.

“Okayyy” landed on Latto’s Big Mama album, which arrived in May and debuted at No. 16 on the Billboard 200.

The surprises didn’t stop there: Doja and Latto will also be hitting the road together. From what appears to be the set of the “Okayyy” video, Doja Cat posted a clip using a vintage camcorder, revealing that Big Mama will be joining her for the North American leg of the Tour Ma Vie World Tour, which kicks off in Detroit on Oct. 1.

The trek is set to be Latto’s first string of arena performances since announcing she gave birth to a baby girl in May.
